about.metaDescription: QR Starr turns a QR card that travels with a gift into a personal digital greeting: a message, photos, video and a voice note, opened with one scan.
about.title: A personal greeting inside every gift
about.lead: QR Starr connects a physical card that travels with a gift to a digital greeting the sender creates on their phone. The recipient scans the card and the greeting opens: a written message, photos, a video and a voice note, in a design the sender chose.
about.stepsLabel: How it works, in four steps

steps.title: Pick up a card
steps.text: A partner shop includes a QR Starr card with your flowers, cake or gift.

steps.title: Create your greeting
steps.text: Scan the card and write a message. Add photos, a video or a voice note, and choose a design.

steps.title: Preview and activate
steps.text: See exactly what the recipient will see, then pay the one-time activation fee.

steps.title: They scan, it opens
steps.text: The recipient scans the same card and your greeting opens on their phone.

blocks.text: QR Starr is a digital greeting service. Each QR Starr card carries its own QR code which, once activated, opens one personal greeting created by the person giving the gift.
There is no app to install and no account to create. Senders and recipients use the camera and browser already on their phone.

items: Every card has its own QR code. Scanning a card that hasn’t been used yet invites you to create a greeting on it.
While the greeting is being written, the card is reserved for it, and only the device that started the greeting can continue editing it.
After activation, scanning the card opens the finished greeting.
One card holds one greeting. Once activated, a greeting can’t be edited.

blocks.text: Every greeting includes a written message of up to {{fact.messageMaxLength}} characters. The sender can also add:

items: up to {{fact.photoCount}} photos;
one video;
one voice note, recorded in the browser (up to {{fact.voiceMaxSeconds}} seconds) or uploaded as a file;
one of {{fact.themeCount}} designs, each with its own typography, colours and opening animation.

blocks.text: Before paying, the sender sees a preview exactly as the recipient will see it. File types and limits are listed on [How it works](/how-it-works).

sections.title: A physical card, a digital experience

blocks.text: The card links the gift to the greeting. The card travels with the gift; the greeting lives online. Because the greeting opens from the card itself, it arrives at the same moment as the gift.

blocks.title: The card is the key
blocks.text: Anyone who holds an activated card, or has its link, can open the greeting. There is no password, so the card should be given only to the person it is meant for.

items: A personal message with photos, video and voice that arrives together with a physical gift.
Nothing to install: everything works in the phone’s browser.
A preview before you pay, and a one-time price shown before payment. No subscription.
Available in Georgian and English.
A ready-made way to add a personal, digital touch to flowers, cakes and gifts.
Printable QR card batches, created and managed in the partner dashboard.
Card inventory and sales reporting in the partner dashboard.
Privacy by design: partners see whether a card has been used, never what a greeting says or shows.

blocks.text: Partnership terms are agreed individually. To become a partner, please [contact us](/contact).

sections.title: Activation: when the greeting becomes available

blocks.text: Your greeting is activated **as soon as your payment is confirmed**. From then on, scanning the card opens it. Nothing is posted or shipped: the greeting is digital and opens from the card.

If a payment can’t be applied to your greeting, for example because it was already paid for in another browser tab, it doesn’t activate anything a second time and the extra payment is returned. See [Delivery and refunds](/delivery-and-refunds).

items: The recipient scans the same card. No app or account is needed.
The greeting opens in the design you chose, with your message, photos, video and voice note.
It can be opened again by scanning the card again.

blocks.text: How long an activated greeting remains available will be stated here.

items: **One card, one greeting.** A card can’t be reused or moved to a different greeting.
**No changes after activation.** Check the preview carefully before paying.
**The card is the key.** Anyone with the activated card or its link can open the greeting; there is no password.
**Editing stays on one device.** Before payment, editing access is kept on the device you started on, for {{fact.editAccessDays}} days.
**An internet connection and an up-to-date mobile browser** are needed to create and to open a greeting.
**Cards can be paused.** A card can’t be started while its partner’s account is paused, and greetings that break our [Terms](/terms) can be blocked.

refunds.metaDescription: How QR Starr greetings are delivered and activated, and when and how you can cancel or get a refund.
refunds.title: Delivery, cancellation and refunds
refunds.lead: How your greeting is delivered, what happens if you change your mind, and when you get your money back.

blocks.text: The activation fee makes your digital greeting available on one QR Starr card. The amount is shown in Georgian lari (GEL) before you pay. See [Pricing](/pricing).

QR Starr cards are handed out by our partner shops together with the gift you buy from them. QR Starr does not post or ship physical items to customers. Questions about the card itself, or about the gift, go to the shop that provided it.
How physical cards reach customers, and whether a card may be charged for separately, will be confirmed here.
Delivery is **immediate and digital**. Your greeting is activated on the card as soon as your payment is confirmed; from then on, scanning the card opens it. Nothing is sent by post.
If a payment fails, nothing is activated and you can try again.
You can stop at any time before completing payment. Nothing is charged, and an unpaid greeting is never shown to anyone.
The draft stays reserved on the card and can be continued from the same device for {{fact.editAccessDays}} days.
Your greeting is digital content delivered immediately at your request, and it can’t be changed once it is activated.

Whether, and on what conditions, the right to withdraw from a distance contract ends once the greeting is activated, including any consent required before payment, must be confirmed under the Law of Georgia on the Protection of Consumer Rights.
This policy does not limit your rights as a consumer under Georgian law.
You receive a **full refund** of the activation fee, to the card you paid with, if:

items: **you were charged but the greeting could not be activated**, for example because it had already been paid for, or the card had been paused;
**you were charged more than once** for the same greeting: the extra payment is returned.

blocks.text: Further refund cases, such as a technical fault on our side that stops an activated greeting from opening, and any time limits, will be stated here.

sections.title: When a refund may not apply

blocks.text: Refusing a refund after activation when you have simply changed your mind must be confirmed against consumer protection law before this policy is published.
Whether the activation fee is refunded when a greeting is blocked for breaking our Terms, and whether a refunded greeting stays available on the card, will be stated here.

items: Email {{merchant.supportEmail}} or call {{merchant.phone}}.
Include the card’s link (the address that opens when you scan the card), the date of payment and the amount.
Tell us briefly what went wrong.

blocks.text: Our response time for refund requests will be stated here.

Refunds are paid back to the card you paid with, through the bank that processed the payment. We refund the full activation fee; partial refunds are not offered. We reply to the email address you wrote from and let you know when the refund has been issued.
How long the bank takes to return a refund to your card will be stated here once confirmed.

If you didn’t make a payment yourself, or you want to dispute a payment, please contact us as well as your bank; we can usually resolve it faster. If a dispute (chargeback) is opened, the bank’s decision applies. We may provide evidence that the greeting was delivered, such as when it was activated and opened, but never its content.
Questions about delivery, cancellation or refunds: {{merchant.supportEmail}}, {{merchant.phone}}. Full company details are on our [Contact](/contact) page.

faq.a: From a partner shop: the card comes with your flowers, cake or gift.

faq.q: Does the recipient need an app or an account?
faq.a: No. They scan the card with their phone camera and the greeting opens in the browser.

faq.q: Can I edit my greeting after paying?
faq.a: Before paying you can change everything, as often as you like. Once a greeting is activated it can’t be edited, so the preview is your final check.

faq.q: Can I start on one phone and finish on another?
faq.a: Editing access stays on the device you started on, for {{fact.editAccessDays}} days. If you switch devices or clear your browser data before paying, you won’t be able to continue the draft.
Anyone who holds the activated card, or has its link. There is no password, so give the card only to the person it is meant for.
